noRerollClaims.reason: Document SELECTION changed, not the income COMPUTATION: INCOME_RE stops admitting closing/settlement/escrow/mortgage/billing/HOA/card statements, while the system prompt and the math are byte-identical. Every file whose selection actually changed re-fingerprints on its own, because the candidate list is already hashed into the stability fingerprint — verify:income names all 8 (Edson Cruz, Helena Kyser Livingston, Stephen Friedlander, Joseph Boykan, Charletha Osborne, Harold Samuel Wrobel, Corine Lucas, Lashone Duncan) and they re-read with no help from LOGIC_VERSION. Every other file keeps the same documents, the same prompt and the same math, so its number cannot move. Bumping would therefore deliver nothing to any file while forcing a fresh non-deterministic re-read on every currently-stable one, including Magali/Milton $19,753 and Asia Dearman's contested $8,645 — the exact trade the 2026-08-16 comment in the route refused.

Adds a landlord/tenant DIRECTION gate to the lease path only (lib/income/rentalIncome.ts), reachable solely through the DSCR branch and solely for lease/rent_roll facts. Measured on the live data 2026-08-21: 55 stored DocFacts across the 10 cached income rows contain ZERO lease/rent_roll/1007 facts, so no cached number has a rental component the gate could change. The readDocument prompt edit sits inside the lease bullet and only reaches a document on a re-read. NOT bumping is the safer half of the choice here: 4 of the 10 cached rows predate factsUsed and cannot be inspected, and bumping would invalidate and re-roll those four on a non-deterministic AI re-read for no benefit.

Excludes credit-card statements from the income read by CONTENT (lib/docContent looksLikeCreditCardStatement). Measured over the live corpus: it rejects exactly 4 documents, all Chase card statements on FF-202609-7039 (Tylor Stone), which has NO cached income. Across all 12 files that DO have a cached number, 106 candidate PDFs were read and zero are excluded, so no shipped number can move. A global LOGIC_VERSION bump would re-roll all 12 settled files through a non-deterministic read to fix a file that has no number yet.

Adds lib/income/driftGate.ts, a READ-ONLY issuance gate, and changes no math. Measured 2026-09-10: (1) reachability — the module is imported by exactly two places, app/api/preapprovals/route.ts and its own guard scripts/verify-income-drift-gate.ts; it is referenced by neither app/api/los/files/[id]/verify-income/route.ts nor lib/income/docFacts.ts, so nothing on the path that computes a borrower's number can reach it. (2) direction — it only CONSUMES computeQualifyingIncome to re-derive a comparison figure from already-stored factsUsed; it defines no rule, mutates no fact and writes no cache. (3) outcome — verify:income-engine-diff on the live corpus reports 'same' for all 11 files it can replay (13580, 4874, 18563, 8627, 20653, 8923, 11784, 19753, 10414, 0, 5667) and the bank-statement modules behind the 12th are byte-unchanged. Bumping LOGIC_VERSION would invalidate all 12 cached numbers and force a fresh non-deterministic AI re-read on every open file to deliver a gate that changes no number — the Asia Dearman trade ($5,102 -> $8,645 on an unasked-for re-roll) for zero benefit.

Captures the bank-statement deposit rows the engine consumes (bankFactsUsed) and routes the bank arm through lib/income/bankReplay.ts so the replay guard and a live verify make the SAME call. Cannot move a number: grep of lib/income/bankStatement.ts shows it reads exactly r.bankStatement and r.personName off a DocRead and both are carried verbatim; the rebuilt resolver returns the captured answer per holder and defaults to 1 for an unknown name, which is what makeBorrowerResolver (c > p ? 2 : 1) also returns. Verified by replaying FF-202607-7963's recorded basis: same $7,364 and the same basis string.
